objective: Graduate single-image input preview with a real local-image MainWindow integration test and concise user documentation, without changing inference or artifact behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A CPU-local qtbot integration drives the actual MainWindow and InferencePage, selects valid and corrupt local images, and verifies preview state and aspect-ratio bounds without invoking a real model forward.

The integration proves browse/manual refresh, invalid-to-valid recovery, Single Image to Folder to Single Image transitions, and coexistence with a fake asynchronous inference lifecycle without stale preview or duplicate widgets.
The test uses deterministic local fixtures and state-based Qt observation only, with no CUDA, network, external download, screenshot comparison, arbitrary sleep, file watcher, or new dependency.
README receives a concise workflow and a clickable relative link to docs/phase13_inference_image_preview.md without unrelated restructuring.

The detailed document distinguishes input preview from inference output, documents decoding/scaling/error/mode behavior, accessibility and resource bounds, compatibility, automated evidence, manual checks, limitations, and explicit non-goals without fabricated results.
Phase 6 through Phase 12 request, thread, cancellation, export, close, artifact, and public API contracts remain unchanged.

No drag-and-drop, folder thumbnail grid, image editing, result-image rendering, EXIF editing, recursive discovery, packaging, installer, TorchScript migration, CUDA inference, or network feature is added.
Existing assertions are not removed or weakened, no unregistered marker is added, and no Git operation is performed.
claude_prompt: Implement Phase 13 CP3 only in tests/gui/test_inference_preview_integration.py, README.md, and docs/phase13_inference_image_preview.md. Add a deterministic local-CPU qtbot graduation test using actual MainWindow/InferencePage and local valid/corrupt image fixtures while using a fake inference backend so no real model forward occurs. Verify browse/manual refresh, invalid recovery, bounded aspect ratio, mode round-trip, lifecycle coexistence and exactly one preview widget through programmatic state rather than screenshots or sleeps. Add a concise README workflow with a relative Markdown link and an accurate detailed document that separates input preview from inference result, automated evidence from conditional/manual checks, and records compatibility, bounds, limitations and non-goals without invented test counts. Do not modify production, other tests, APIs, schemas, dependencies, goals, manifests, config, or user settings; do not add drag/drop, folder thumbnails, editing, result rendering, packaging, TorchScript migration, CUDA/network work, or Git operations.
estimated_scope: One focused GUI integration test plus concise README and detailed design documentation, approximately 260-420 changed lines.
